statement.zh: Burger 1984 专著建立查文德万塔尔史前占用与陶瓷序列的基础田野框架（UCP Anthropology 14）。
statement.en: Burger 1984 establishes a foundational field frame for prehistoric occupation and ceramic sequence at Chavín de Huántar (UCP Anthropology 14).
